about: Plain-language layer for BloomBurger's feed and day map: one question per topic, the two answers, and one sentence per segment on what it said. Claude draft 2026-10-17 — Sailor's to edit. Scores are untouched; this is only how they are worded on the page.

diesel.name: The Russian diesel deal
diesel.q: Will the Russian diesel deal help?

strait.name: The Strait of Hormuz
strait.q: Is the Strait of Hormuz open under US control?

crunch.name: The fuel shortage
crunch.q: Is the fuel shortage hurting the economy?

msnow_2026-10-15_putins_windfall.said: Ali Velshi and Chrystia Freeland said the deal will barely move US prices and mostly helps Putin, with money and legitimacy.

bp_2026-10-16_out_of_ships.said: Breaking Points said ships are being hit in the Strait faster than they can be replaced, so it isn't really open.

close_2026-10-16.said: Bloomberg's The Close said high gas prices are starting to cut into consumer spending, as oil rose and stocks fell.

nyt_2026-10-15_gulf_oil_flowing_lede.said: The Times reported Gulf oil is still moving despite more attacks on ships; two tanker trackers disagree on whether the flow is rising.

nyt_2026-10-14_the_daily_diesel_deal.said: The Daily said the diesel is less than one day of US use, and that the deal pays Moscow without getting anything back.

nyt_2026-10-14_diesel_deal_lede.said: The Times said the Russian diesel is too small to bring down US prices.

close_2026-10-15.said: The Close treated fuel costs as something companies pass on to customers, not as a shortage.

bp_2026-10-15_texas_trail.said: Breaking Points' hosts and a forecaster all leaned toward Talarico taking Texas's Senate seat.

bp_2026-10-15_hormuz.said: Breaking Points set CENTCOM's 19-million-barrel claim against sunk tankers, attacks and soaring freight costs, and said the US doesn't control the Strait.

fp_2026-10-13_diesel_deal_lede.said: The Free Press called the deal a desperate, embarrassing failure that won't lower prices.

bp_2026-10-12_diesel.said: Breaking Points said Trump announced the diesel deal and a ceasefire before either happened, and that the diesel is a small share of US supply.

aj_2026-10-12_energy_ceasefire.said: Al Jazeera laid out the history of US sanctions on Russian oil; its guests split on whether the deal will matter.

ol_2026-10-05_fuel_hedging.said: Odd Lots explained how airlines hedge fuel costs; its hosts split on whether the shortage is hurting or being absorbed.

tc_2026-09-23_refineries.said: Tucker Carlson said refinery damage has pushed fuel past what most people can pay.
